description: This file implements 2D average pooling for quantized tensors in PyTorch, including functions for CPU execution, support for QNNPACK acceleration, and handling of different tensor memory formats.

methods.name: avg_pool2d_out_frame
methods.description: Performs average pooling on a frame of the input tensor, handling quantization and padding.

methods.name: get_kernel
methods.description: Extracts kernel size dimensions from input array.

methods.name: get_stride
methods.description: Determines stride dimensions based on input parameters.

methods.name: get_padding
methods.description: Calculates padding dimensions from input array.

methods.name: get_output_shape
methods.description: Computes output tensor shape based on input shape and pooling parameters.

methods.name: q_avg_pool2d
methods.description: Performs quantized 2D average pooling, dispatching to optimized implementations based on tensor format.

methods.name: avg_pool2d_quantized_cpu
methods.description: Main entry point for quantized 2D average pooling on CPU, supporting QNNPACK acceleration.
